name: glm-tp2-mtp
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. GLM-5.3-Flash 2.25bpw as a two-rank tensor-parallel group WITH NextN (MTP) speculation (lane L12, docs/GLM_TP.md section 9): N1 = rank 0, N4 = rank 1, each owning half of the routed experts (0..144 | 144..288) of every MoE layer AND of the NextN layer (one all-reduce per forward of that layer: each prefill chunk, each draft call's absorb, each further draft depth). Rank 0 runs the speculation runtime (--spec auto: its arbiter; the depth and the keyed-noise samplers travel in the draft call); rank 1 replays. Text only: --no-vision, --prefix-cache off, pinned --slots and --kv-tokens. tools/glm_tp_mtp_two_node.sh derives the --spec mtp (REXL3_MTP_DEPTH=3) and --spec none legs from this file. N2 and N3 are the gn100s: disabled by owner rule, listed so that a rank map naming them is refused.
